logs_meta_description: Paste or drop a RedLoader, BepInEx or Player.log file and get a private link that deletes itself after 24 hours. Personal data is removed first.
logs_intro: Paste or drop your log so someone can help you. Personal data is removed before it is saved.
logs_privacy_text: Windows user names in file paths, Steam IDs, IP addresses, e-mails, tokens and keys are replaced before the log is stored.
logs_expiry_notice: This link and its content are deleted automatically after 24 hours.
logs_drop_hint: Drop a .log, .txt, .gz or .zip file anywhere in this box
logs_drop_active: Drop the file to load it
logs_err_empty: Paste or drop a log first.
logs_err_too_large: That log is larger than {max}. Send only the part around the problem.
logs_err_binary: That does not look like a text log.
logs_err_file_type: Use a .log or .txt file, or a .gz or .zip that contains one.
logs_err_network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
logs_err_turnstile: The human check failed. Try again.
logs_err_rate: Too many requests — try again in {seconds} s
logs_err_busy: Log sharing is busy right now. Try again in a few minutes.
logs_done_delete_hint: Keep it to delete the log early. Anyone with this link can delete the log.
logs_delete_confirm: Delete this log now? The link stops working immediately.
logs_meta_viewer_description: A shared game log. The private link deletes itself after 24 hours.
logs_gone_expired: Shared logs are deleted automatically after 24 hours. Ask for a new link or share the log again.
logs_gone_reported: This log was removed after abuse reports.
logs_unavailable_text: We could not load this log right now. Try again in a moment.
logs_hint_comments: Something not working? Share your log and paste the link in your comment.
logs_hint_install: Something not working? Share your log so others can help you.
